spec_source: Tommy Slack 12:15 (edited version) + 2026-08-12 model-size note ("stronger than Qwen2.5-7B") + WIN4070 track's FINDING_GROUP_SIZE_REWARD_VARIANCE.md / EXPERIMENT_2_4070_INSTRUCT_V9_AMENDMENT.md
forked_from: experiment 2/exp2_colab_config.json (full-scope committed version, unchanged and not retracted)
status: MVP scope registered 2026-08-16; phase 0 not started
merge_note: 2026-08-12: merges two independent needs for a >=24GB GPU into one Colab run rather than running them separately - Tommy's ask for a model stronger than Qwen2.5-7B, and the WIN4070 track's v9 finding that GRPO group size 3 leaves most Math prompt groups with zero within-group reward variance (dead gradient) and group 8 needs >=24GB. Operator decision (Aaron), confirmed 2026-08-12.
model_variant_contingency: kept Base over Instruct despite the WIN4070 track switching to Instruct (v1-v9), because 7B >> 0.5B and format-following (boxed-answer emission) is expected to be far less of a problem at this scale than it was for the 0.5B track. NOT yet verified. If Phase 0's sparse-reward preflight or smoke test shows persistent boxed-format failures on the base model, switch to Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and log the deviation - do not silently push through degraded format compliance.

dataset.loader_note: heterogeneous parquet schemas under train/*.parquet - datasets==5.0.0 cannot cast to one unified Dataset; load MATH_FILE/SIM_FILE independently (src/guru_data.py, adapted from the confirmed exp2_4070_data.py loader)
dataset.prompt_field: prompt (list of role/content messages, rendered via tokenizer.apply_chat_template)
dataset.source_limitation: the released math parquet merges DAPO and OR1 into one data_source value; a defensible per-origin DAPO-vs-OR1 split is not recoverable from the released fields
dataset.confirmed_by: data/guru_schema_audit.json (WIN4070 track, 2026-08-04/05) - re-verified, not re-discovered, for this 7B/Colab run

peft.note: first-pass default; this project has not trained a LoRA adapter before this run

stage_a.reward_mode_rationale: matches the WIN4070 v8/v9 recipe - pure exact-match at this population's low base accuracy leaves most GRPO groups with zero variance (FINDING_GROUP_SIZE_REWARD_VARIANCE.md); the 0.1 boxed-format bonus recovers some gradient, mostly formatting signal not reasoning signal per that finding, reported honestly not as free lift
stage_a.learning_rate_rationale: literature-typical order of magnitude for LoRA-adapter GRPO; UNVALIDATED, not derived from a dose-response study like the 4070 exp2's 5.5e-6 full-parameter dose. Not comparable to prior full-parameter doses. See plan §1.1/§1.3/§8.
stage_a.num_generations_rationale: merged decision: matches the WIN4070 v9 group-size fix (3->8), tested for the same reason on the same Math population and confirmed to need >=24GB - see merge_note. Bumped from an earlier group-4 default chosen only for 7B memory headroom, before the v9 finding was known.
stage_a.max_completion_length_rationale: matches v9 (bumped from a shorter cap to avoid truncating multi-step Math reasoning before a boxed answer is emitted)
stage_a.mvp_descope_note: 200->100 updates, checkpoints [0,100,200]->[0,50,100]. This is NOT a new deviation: it is exactly the de_scope_fallback_max_steps / de_scope_fallback_checkpoint_steps already pre-registered in the full-scope config and in plan section 4 de-scope priority item 2. Still three checkpoints (Tommy's stated floor), still ckpt-0 as the stage-2-alone baseline. Cost: less stage-1 exposure per checkpoint, so a weaker dose range on the x-axis of any Q-vs-adaptability correlation.
stage_a.max_completion_length_mvp_note: DELIBERATELY NOT CUT from 1280. Shortening stage-A completions is the single cheapest-looking saving here and it is forbidden: truncating multi-step Math reasoning before a boxed answer is emitted destroys the reward signal, which is the exact failure mode that already ended the WIN4070 v8 run. Cut updates, not completion length.

stage_b.num_generations_rationale: applied uniformly with stage_a for the same shared training-geometry reason v9 did, even though the reward-variance finding was measured on Math specifically - Phase 0's sparse-reward preflight runs on both stages and will catch it if Simulation does not have the same problem at group 4
stage_b.mvp_descope_note: 50->30 updates, eval points 6->4. Endpoint and AUC both remain readable. Applied uniformly to all three cells - a mixed-budget grid is not a fixed-budget experiment and would be uninterpretable.
stage_b.max_completion_length_deviation: DEVIATION, 384 -> 640, registered 2026-08-16. Cause: the WIN4070 v8 post-stop Stage-B cell at ckpt100/seed42 safety-stopped at update 23 with completions/clipped_ratio rising 0.1094 -> 0.1719 -> 0.2344 against the ">10% clipping for 5 consecutive updates" stop. That is a recipe-length failure, not a training failure: CodeIO's structured-JSON answers were being cut off. 640 matches stage_b max_prompt_length and the token audit (data/token_length_audit.json). CONSEQUENCE: this changes the fixed-budget recipe, so all three cells must run under 640 and NO cell may be compared against a 384-token cell from any earlier run.
stage_b.clipping_stop_unchanged: the >10%-for-5-updates stop is NOT relaxed. The fix is to give the model enough room to finish, not to stop noticing that it cannot.

execution.device_tier_expectation: A100 is the realistic default here, not just the fallback - stacking a 7B base (vs 0.5B) AND group-8 generation (vs the group-4 default this config had before the merge) compounds two independent memory-pressure increases. L4 is still tried first (cheaper compute-unit draw) but do not be surprised when Gate C0 escalates.

gates.phase0a_note: the real token audit (data/token_length_audit.json, WIN4070 track) already found stage-B max_prompt_tokens=640 - this gate is expected to pass comfortably, confirmed rather than assumed
gates.phase0b_sparse_reward_preflight: tightened per the v9 finding: STOP unless >= min_variable_groups have variable COMBINED reward; separately record and report exact-channel variance (FINDING_GROUP_SIZE_REWARD_VARIANCE.md section 9, 'a gate defined on the exact channel would be the stronger instrument' - reported, not silently adopted as the gate itself, since that would be stricter than what any team run has used)

outcomes.P1_delta_R: R_end(ckpt0) - R_end(ckpt_t), R_end = mean stage-B eval reward at update 50
outcomes.P3_transfer_T: T_t = Score_B(M_{A,t}) - Score_B(M_0), zero-shot, no stage-2 training
outcomes.reading_rule: delta_R is interpreted conditional on T_t; T_t far from 0 means delta_R is transfer-confounded and must be reported as such

measurement.note: beyond Tommy's spec but in scope for this owner; gates nothing in phase 3
measurement.probe_rationale: hidden dim is 3584 for Qwen2.5-7B; a probe smaller than the hidden dim makes effective-rank magnitudes sample-truncated and n-dependent (same reasoning as the 0.5B plan's 512-vs-896 case, one level up)
measurement.probe_source: frozen at Phase 0 in data/exp2_colab_splits.json: stage-B pool rows disjoint from stage-B train and eval, topped up from held-out stage-A rows if the CodeI/O pool is too small; per-source counts recorded in the splits file
measurement.layers_rationale: rescaled from the 0.5B plan's [4,12,22] of 24 blocks to the same relative depths (~18%/50%/93%) of Qwen2.5-7B's 28 blocks
measurement.ckpt0_identity_gate: within-run re-measurement consistency check only; NOT compared to the 0.5B pilot reference value (different model, not comparable in magnitude)
measurement.model_dtype_correction: CORRECTED 2026-08-16. The full-scope config declared "float32", but pipeline.measure_checkpoint_q() calls build_peft_model(), which unconditionally loads the base in bfloat16 and upcasts only LoRA parameters - the model_dtype field was never read by any code path. Declaring fp32 was also infeasible at this scale: fp32 weights for a 7B model are ~28 GB, which does not fit an L4 at all. All checkpoints are measured under identical dtype, so within-run comparability (the property the comparability rule actually requires) holds. Q values from this run are NOT numerically comparable to the WIN4070 track's float32 measurements.
measurement.probe_questions_mvp_note: 4096 KEPT, not cut. Qwen2.5-7B hidden dim is 3584; a probe below that makes effective rank sample-truncated, i.e. the metric stops measuring what it claims to. If Phase 2b must be shortened, cut the ckpt-0 identity re-measurement pass (4 passes -> 3) before touching n_probe, and if that is still not enough drop Phase 2b entirely per plan section 4 de-scope priority item 4 - it gates nothing in Phase 3.

open_team_questions: Does 'stronger than Qwen2.5-7B' mean exactly 7B is acceptable, or strictly larger?
LoRA vs full fine-tuning for this arm specifically, if other members' stage-1 arms stay full-parameter at smaller sizes - this is a second confound on top of the task-pair difference
Stage-1 LoRA learning rate 2e-5 is unvalidated; no dose-response study has been run for LoRA GRPO on this model family

Base vs Instruct model - kept Base for this run (model_variant_contingency above), contingent on the Phase 0 smoke test not showing format-following collapse; the WIN4070 track already moved to Instruct with real supporting evidence at 0.5B scale
Committed scope (3 checkpoints x 1 seed) is smaller than the 4070 run's superset (5 x 3) - a time/budget decision, not a claim of sufficiency

Compute-unit budget ownership for this run - not part of the eaaj-pilot ~300-unit allocation in CLAUDE.md, and now also overlaps in purpose with the WIN4070 track's own Colab/L4 ask for the group-8 test
This run is not dose-comparable to exp1.6/exp1.7 or to the 4070 exp2 run (architecture change: LoRA vs full-parameter)

The exact-format gate (>=2/16 combined-variable groups) is looser than the exact-channel-only gate FINDING_GROUP_SIZE_REWARD_VARIANCE.md argues is the stronger instrument - using the looser gate to match precedent, not because it's been shown sufficient

mvp.reason: operator decision (Aaron): keep Tommy's >=7B model requirement and absorb the 2026-08-23 abstract deadline entirely on the SCOPE axis instead. Zero GPU-hours of real throughput data exist for LoRA GRPO at any scale in this project, so the full-scope schedule cannot be defended as feasible; this fork commits to the smallest scope that still yields a COMPLETE (not truncated) Delta-R curve.
mvp.model_unchanged: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B - the >=7B ask is NOT de-scoped
mvp.promotion_gate: if Phase 0 measured s/update implies the full-scope schedule (stage_a 200 updates, stage_b 50 updates x 3 cells) finishes before 2026-08-23 with >=30% calendar margin, run the full scope from exp2_colab_config.json instead and discard this fork unused. Decide ONCE, at the end of Phase 0, never mid-run.

mvp_deliverable.primary: one COMPLETE fixed-budget Delta-R curve: R_B(ckpt_t) - R_B(ckpt_0) at t in {0,50,100}, seed 42, 30-update budget, 300 frozen CodeIO eval questions
mvp_deliverable.secondary: T_t zero-shot transfer at the same three checkpoints (Phase 2) - NOT cuttable, Delta-R is unreadable without it
mvp_deliverable.tertiary: Q(t) effective rank / dormant fraction at the same three checkpoints (Phase 2b)
mvp_deliverable.honest_limits: n=3 checkpoints, 1 seed, LoRA-adapter subspace not full parameter space, stage-A learning rate 2e-5 unvalidated. Any Q-vs-adaptability relationship is an exploratory description with no inferential claim. Say this in the abstract; do not report a rank correlation over three points as evidence.
